hints.title: Negative Element Removal
hints.text: Removing positive elements never increases a subarray sum, so only negative values warrant trial removal.

hints.title: Subarray Merge Properties
hints.text: Maintain standard maximum prefix, suffix, and total subarray sum properties within a segment tree.

hints.title: Temporary Zero Updates
hints.text: For each distinct negative value, set its indices to 0, query the root maximum subarray sum, and revert.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Each index is updated twice in a segment tree with O(log n) overhead.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running Kadane for each distinct negative value requires O(n * u) which hits quadratic limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) segment tree tracks prefix, suffix, and range sums dynamically.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models dynamic subarray sum updates with segment tree and restricts trials to negative elements.
